activation_rule: This lab runs only after an explicit Front offline-mode command. Close-office selects CLOSED and must not start simulation/data gathering.
purpose: Run unattended evidence-gathering playthroughs and passive data collection using the latest validated mod build while engineering desks are powered down.
build_rule: Use the newest semantically accepted/validated mod build, never a merely staged or failed candidate.
save_rule: Original dynasty saves are immutable; simulation may use hashed disposable clones/branches only.
evidence_rule: Capture world snapshots, AI decisions, incidents, movement, wars, economy, relationships, performance, errors, operator actions and outcomes with timestamps/provenance.
promotion_rule: Offline evidence is unreviewed. It may not change code, architecture, policies, roadmap, acceptance status, or breakthrough claims until OPEN and Analyzer reviews it.
control_rule: Use validated native Bannerlord/TestRunner/operator interfaces; fail closed on unknown blockers; no human-style tactical control unless separately validated.
